::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 18 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Columbia University Library
:::

[Gentlemen](organizations/other_248.qmd)

I am much obliged for the [draft for £10](organizations/other_172.qmd) received this morning as well as the copies of the [Story of the Christians and Moors](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd), which I am very glad to have in this cheap form. I am much obliged for your liberality in the matter, and 

remain &c
C M Yonge
